learning_outcomes.text: After successful completion of the module, students will know the difference between Quality Management (QM) and Quality Assurance (QA).
They will understand the necessity of quality management and be aware of the challenges in its implementation.
They will be able to systematically address and sustainably resolve simpler problems.
Students will be familiar with rudimentary approaches for complex problems.
Students will be able to collaborate in a team with a Six Sigma specialist and support the introduction of a quality management system according to the ISO 9000 family in a company.

Through practical exercises in the QA laboratory, students will be familiar with the procedures and statistical backgrounds of measurement system analyses and will be able to perform them independently.

Through the experience gained in practical work with different measurement systems, students will be able to recognize the strengths and weaknesses of measurement systems and the associated measurement uncertainties.
Students will be able to actively use these findings in industrial daily life and develop suggestions for improvement.

syllabus_topics: Methods and tools of quality management
Structure of quality management systems according to ISO9000 Key figure definition
Application of quality concepts (e.g., Six Sigma, Quality Gates, Control loops)
Use of MS-Excel for evaluation of measurement series
Practical work with the 3D coordinate measuring machine
Setup and programming of an industrial image processing system
Determination of the gauge capability of an optical measuring station
Content must significantly differ from the compulsory MECB program
teaching_methods: Elective course dependent on chosen event

assessment_methods.method: MECB711 Quality Management (Lecture): graded, written examination, duration: 60 min or presentation over 20 minutes or written elaboration
MECB712 Quality Assurance (Laboratory): ungraded, written laboratory reports
MECB713 Elective Module, according to the requirements of the elective module

assessment_rules: The module grade for MECB710 is determined in equal parts from the grade of the MECB711 examination and the grade of the elective module (if a grade can be determined based on the graded partial examinations based on the awarded CP). If only the grade for MECB711 is available, then this corresponds to the module grade MECB710. For each elective module, at least one graded examination must be included. In case of multiple graded performances, the grade for MECB713 is calculated with a weighting based on the respective CPs.
